INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AJUTHORITY OF INDIA
**Title:** Circular **Reference No.:** IRDAI/INT/Cir/Misc/ 087/04/2020 Additional time allowed for filing Regulatory Returns to all insurance intermediaries # **CIRCULAR** Ref: IRDAI/INT/Cir/Misc/ 087/04/2020 9th April, 2020 # **To All Insurance Intermediaries** # **Re: Additional time allowed for filing Regulatory Returns to all insurance intermediaries** This circular is issued further to the Press Release dated 23.03.2020 as an addendum. # ***Additional Time allowed for filing Regulatory Returns as at 31.03.2020** a) Half-Yearly and Yearly Returns: 30 days b) Cyber Security Audit: 30 days *It may be noted that this time is granted in addition to the time normally available for filing the above returns. This is issued with the approval of the Competent Authority. # **(T.L. Alamelu)** # **Member (Distn)**

chunks.heading: **Re: Additional time allowed for filing Regulatory Returns to all insurance intermediaries**
chunks.content: This circular is issued further to the Press Release dated 23.03.2020 as an addendum.

chunks.heading: ***Additional Time allowed for filing Regulatory Returns as at 31.03.2020**
chunks.content:
a) Half-Yearly and Yearly Returns: 30 days 

b) Cyber Security Audit: 30 days 

*It may be noted that this time is granted in addition to the time normally available for filing the above returns. 

This is issued with the approval of the Competent Authority.
